world_app_description: A WLD plan for someone you love.
description_overview: Make a WLD plan for someone you love. Choose an heir and a renewal period, create a personal vault, and keep its countdown renewed. The basic vault holds WLD without a platform fee. An optional yield vault supplies WLD to Re7 WLD on Morpho and charges 10% of positive net WLD gains, including claimed campaign rewards, on exit, after underlying fees; no principal or management fee applies. Returns vary, principal can lose value, and cash withdrawals depend on liquidity. If your named heir requests inheritance after expiry, a fixed seven-day review follows. Monitored new vaults can then transfer automatically to the fixed heir. You can renew to cancel the claim until transfer executes. Yield inheritance can pay receipt shares instead of WLD cash. This is a smart-contract transfer plan, not a legal will.
description_how_it_works:
1. Sign in with World App wallet authentication. World ID verification is not required.
2. Choose basic WLD custody or the separate, optional Morpho yield vault. Read the yield fee, loss and receipt-inheritance terms before selecting yield. Each type has its own heir, balance and countdown; existing funds never move automatically.
3. Name a contact, username or wallet address and choose 1 to 365 days. Create the vault, then approve and deposit WLD. Tell your heir through World Chat or a shared link. Reminders are optional; each recipient needs their own notification permission.
4. Renew before your countdown ends. After expiry, the named heir can file a claim and wait seven days. Funds stay in the vault during review. The owner can renew until transfer actually executes.
5. After review, monitored new vaults can transfer automatically. The heir can also complete an eligible inheritance in World App; earlier basic vaults require manual completion. Network, funding and service delays can affect timing.
6. Yield withdrawals and inheritance first try WLD cash redemption. If cash inheritance fails, receipt shares and idle WLD go to the fixed heir; any positive-gain service fee is paid in shares at their quoted WLD value. Wallet-held shares can later be redeemed as liquidity permits without a second service fee.
7. Claim available WLD campaign rewards and reinvest them without increasing principal or resetting the countdown. Rewards already delivered by approved external operators can be processed without an API proof. Rewards published after inheritance go to the fixed recipient after the same net-gain fee and loss recovery, including during owner recovery. Keep the vault link even if its empty slot is released.

Underlying vault fees and risks can change. Campaign rewards vary; World App's verified-human boost is not automatic for a personal vault contract. There is no fixed APY or guarantee of principal. Network transaction fees may apply.
description_connect: Our server verifies a one-use World App wallet signature and issues a one-hour wallet-bound session. User-approved WLD, factory and Re7 WLD receipt-token transactions run on World Chain. User private keys and seed phrases are never collected. The monitoring service stores registered addresses, vault state, alert history and gas execution records; short-lived security records protect sign-in and API access. A dedicated infrastructure signer pays network gas only for an eligible transfer to the contract's fixed heir. It cannot file the heir's claim, redirect funds or withdraw an active owner's balance. The yield factory's strategy, service fee and fee recipient are fixed at deployment; there are no admin, upgrade or strategy-switch permissions in our contracts. The underlying Morpho vault has its own curator and governance risks. No independent third-party security audit has been performed. Read the Privacy Policy, Terms and Yield Terms in the app.
